pairs.question: Quonam modo vis aurem meam interrogem?
pairs.answer: Quo suam Vergilius percontatus est, qui diversis in locis "urbis" et "urbes" dixit arbitrio consilioque usus auris.
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange: the questioner ("is, qui quaesierat") asks how he should consult his ear, after Probus told him to do so; Probus replies (frame "Et Probum ait respondisse:" dropped). Question stripped of the inline "inquit" tag. Answer cut at the first full stop after the operative reply ("...usus auris."); what follows ("IV. Nam in primo georgicon...") is elaboration/examples, omitted.
